source: 14 deep-unit JSONs (interlocutors arrays) aggregated and de-duplicated; cross-checked with Index pp. 540-551

tier_definitions.A: Appears as named interlocutor across >=3 units (volume-wide structural interlocutor)

interlocutors.name: Aristotle
interlocutors.primary_function_for_burke: Volume-spanning lexical authority for act-philosophy; the technical-term donor (hylomorphism, four causes, energeia/dynamis, entelechy) and the structural exemplar for what dramatistic-act terminology should look like.

interlocutors.name: Coleridge
interlocutors.primary_function_for_burke: Primary Romantic-poetic interlocutor; the bridge between poetics and metaphysics. Biographia Literaria furnishes the imagination-doctrine and dialectical-organic-form vocabulary that Burke generalizes into pentadic apparatus.

interlocutors.name: Spinoza
interlocutors.primary_function_for_burke: Volume-wide paradigm of scene-philosophy at maximum dialectical refinement; the negation-formula and pantheist substance-doctrine are reread as Scene-term machinery.

interlocutors.name: Plato
interlocutors.primary_function_for_burke: The dialectical-transcendence archetype; Socratic ascent from particulars through merger-and-division to an ultimate term grounds Burke's Dialectic-in-General chapter.

interlocutors.name: Aquinas
interlocutors.primary_function_for_burke: Christianizer of Aristotelian act-philosophy; actus-status and grace-act linkage furnish a theological extension of the Act lexicon.

interlocutors.name: Hegel
interlocutors.primary_function_for_burke: Dialectical-syntax donor (Aufhebung, cunning-of-reason, world-historical); part-source of the four-master-tropes apparatus via merger-and-division.

interlocutors.name: Kant
interlocutors.primary_function_for_burke: Hinge from scene-philosophy to agent-philosophy; transcendental apparatus is recoded as the philosophical-school featuring Agent.

interlocutors.name: Korzybski
interlocutors.primary_function_for_burke: Running critical foil whose Structural Differential exemplifies the non-representative reductive anecdote; Burke adopts terminological self-awareness while rejecting the apparatus.

interlocutors.name: Leibniz
interlocutors.primary_function_for_burke: Transitional scene-to-agent figure; the monad is read as proto-agent; pre-established harmony anticipates logical-positivist scientism.

interlocutors.name: Marx
interlocutors.primary_function_for_burke: Class-as-dramatistic-agent; supplying both a representative-anecdote text (Manifesto) and a dialectical-materialist scene-act vocabulary.

interlocutors.name: William James
interlocutors.primary_function_for_burke: Twentieth-century interlocutor for act-as-locus-of-motives; pragmatist circumference and Varieties supply agency-purpose models.

interlocutors.name: G. H. Mead
interlocutors.primary_function_for_burke: Symbolic-interactionist anchor for the social-act doctrine; vocal-gesture grounds Burke's dramatism in social-psychology.

interlocutors.name: Santayana
interlocutors.primary_function_for_burke: Hybrid skeptical-materialist-cum-Platonist whose doubled grammar Burke takes as a mid-twentieth-century scene-agent integration attempt.

interlocutors.name: Baldwin's Dictionary of Philosophy and Psychology
interlocutors.primary_function_for_burke: Standing lexicon for school-definitions across the philosophical-schools chapters; the tacit authority informing terminological taxonomy.

interlocutors.name: Augustine
interlocutors.primary_function_for_burke: Patristic purpose-philosopher; the Christianized peregrinatio supplies a literary-theological purpose-trajectory.

interlocutors.name: I. A. Richards
interlocutors.primary_function_for_burke: Contemporary new-critical interlocutor; Principles of Literary Criticism is a co-text against which the pentad is positioned.

interlocutors.name: Hobbes
interlocutors.primary_function_for_burke: Foundational modern materialist scene-philosopher; Leviathan as constitutional-political application of scene-philosophy.

interlocutors.name: Darwin
interlocutors.primary_function_for_burke: Modern materialist scene-philosopher whose natural-selection schema is reread as a scene-derived agent.

interlocutors.name: Hume
interlocutors.primary_function_for_burke: Empiricist pivot preparing Kant's transcendental rescue; bundle-self and causation-as-custom destabilize substance.

interlocutors.name: Berkeley
interlocutors.primary_function_for_burke: British-empiricist passage to subjective idealism; esse est percipi reframes agent as constitutive of scene.

interlocutors.name: Locke
interlocutors.primary_function_for_burke: Reference-point for representational empiricism; tabula rasa is read as scene-stressed agent-formation.

interlocutors.name: Lenin
interlocutors.primary_function_for_burke: Vanguard-party as Agency-form attached to Marxian Agent-term; operationalization of Marxism in practice.

interlocutors.name: Freud
interlocutors.primary_function_for_burke: Modern motive-theorist whose ego/super-ego/libido is read dramatistically; psychoanalysis as agency-mechanism.

interlocutors.name: Wordsworth
interlocutors.primary_function_for_burke: Compact pentadic exemplar source; the sonnets are mined as concise scene-agent ratios.

interlocutors.name: T. S. Eliot
interlocutors.primary_function_for_burke: Twentieth-century poetic interlocutor with whom Burke triangulates the modernist-religious motive-vocabulary.

interlocutors.name: Shakespeare
interlocutors.primary_function_for_burke: Source of dramatic illustrations; Hamlet, Othello, Coriolanus furnish illustrative-block instances for pentadic ratios.

interlocutors.name: Bergson
interlocutors.primary_function_for_burke: Counter-mechanist resource: elan vital and purposiveness-in-the-negative cross-read with Darwin.

interlocutors.name: Duns Scotus
interlocutors.primary_function_for_burke: Haecceitas-donor; thisness as the individuating principle within the realist-family.

interlocutors.name: Windelband
interlocutors.primary_function_for_burke: Doxographic source-authority for the philosophical-school taxonomy organizing Part II.

interlocutors.name: Rousseau
interlocutors.primary_function_for_burke: Constitutional-political reference; social-contract and natural-man trope frame Dialectic-of-Constitutions.

interlocutors.name: Plotinus
interlocutors.primary_function_for_burke: Neo-Platonist purpose-philosopher; emanation-and-return as archetypal purpose-trajectory.

interlocutors.name: Dewey
interlocutors.primary_function_for_burke: Second-generation pragmatist whose instrumentalism is the explicit agency-philosophy paired with James.

interlocutors.name: Engels
interlocutors.primary_function_for_burke: Marx's pentadic co-partner; the pre-constitution Marx-Engels supplies a representative-anecdote pairing.

interlocutors.name: Lucretius
interlocutors.primary_function_for_burke: Epicurean variant of scene-philosophy; atoms-and-void plus clinamen as proto-agency.

interlocutors.name: Marcus Aurelius / Epictetus (Stoics)
interlocutors.primary_function_for_burke: Providential-materialist counterpart to Epicurean scene-philosophy.
